text: dsh-custom-instructions 是面向 DSH 网页端的自定义指令插件，会在通用设置中加入一个可编辑全局指令的面板。面板通过本机网页服务读取和保存 DSH 配置目录中的 AGENTS.md 文件，主机端提供读取与写入接口，客户端显示文本编辑区并反馈保存状态。保存后的内容供 DSH 的全局指令机制使用，适合希望为不同会话维护统一背景说明或回答偏好的用户。安装后无需 API 密钥或外部账号。

dsh-custom-instructions adds a global instruction editor to DSH web settings. It reads and saves the local AGENTS.md file, with save status shown in the panel. The text serves DSH’s global instruction mechanism across conversations. It needs no API key or external account.
想在 DSH 网页设置里维护每个会话都能用的全局说明
怎样编辑 DSH 使用的 AGENTS.md 全局指令文件？
I want to manage shared instructions for my DSH conversations from the web settings.
dsh-custom-instructions 的功能「编辑全局指令」：在 DSH 网页通用设置中显示文本编辑框，打开时读取本机 AGENTS.md，点击保存后将编辑内容写回该文件并显示结果。

dsh-custom-instructions README · dsh-custom-instructions：Codex-style custom instructions for **DeepSeek Harness**: edit a **global instruction** from the settings panel that applies to every conversation on this machine, across all models.

Just like Codex's global `AGENTS.md` or ChatGPT's Custom Instructions, the notes and context you write in the "Custom Instructions" panel are automatically carried into every future conversation — no need to repeat yourself in every message.

dsh-custom-instructions README · Features：- **Codex-style custom instructions**: Settings → General → "Custom Instructions", edits `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`, saved straight to disk.
- **Applies to every session and every model**: built on DSH's built-in `dsh-agent-instructions` mechanism — new conversations pick it up from the first message; the current conversation picks it up after the next file operation.
- **WYSIWYG**: monospace editor mirrors the file content; saving gives immediate success/failure feedback.
- **Zero build**: hand-written `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` client bundle + pure Node ESM host — no build authorization needed to install.

dsh-custom-instructions README · From GitHub (this repo)：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:lyke-61/dsh-custom-instructions
```

Then restart `dsh web` once so the bundle layer loads.

dsh-custom-instructions README · ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：- insert:
    - id: custom-instructions
      name: dsh-custom-instructions
```

3. Run `pnpm install` in the profile directory, then restart `dsh web`.

dsh-custom-instructions README · How it works：| Layer | File | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host | `lib/index.js` | Registers `GET/POST /custom-instructions` routes on the webServer to read/write `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`; the path is resolved via `@deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths` — the same file `dsh-agent-instructions` reads |
| Client | `lib/client.js` | Registers the "Custom Instructions" panel in the General settings slot (`settings.general.item`, id `custom-instructions`, right below "Permissions"); loads content via `fetch` on open, saves via `POST` |
| Bundle | `cordis.patch.yml` | The loader row that mounts both halves |

dsh-custom-instructions README · How it works：**Effect mechanism**: the panel edits the very global-instruction file `dsh-agent-instructions` injects into every session, so the plugin needs no hot-reload of its own — new sessions see it immediately; the current session picks it up after the next `read` / `write` / `edit` file operation.

dsh-custom-instructions README · Compatibility：- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6` (web profile).
- Depends on the built-in `dsh-agent-instructions` (shipped with the `standard` preset by default); if your profile disables it, the instructions won't be injected.

dsh-custom-instructions README · Development：The client bundle is hand-written in the exact wire format (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`), so no build step is required:

```bash
node --check lib/index.js
node --check lib/client.js
```
